    Structure Refinement: NCAF, WISH¶

    This example demonstrates a Rietveld refinement of Na2Ca3Al2F14 crystal structure using time-of-flight neutron powder diffraction data from WISH at ISIS.

    Two datasets from detector banks 5+6 and 4+7 are used for joint fitting.

    🛠️ Import Library¶

    In [2]:
    Copied! 
    from easydiffraction import ExperimentFactory
from easydiffraction import Project
from easydiffraction import StructureFactory
from easydiffraction import download_data
    from easydiffraction import ExperimentFactory from easydiffraction import Project from easydiffraction import StructureFactory from easydiffraction import download_data

    🧩 Define Structure¶

    This section covers how to add structures and modify their parameters.

    Create Structure¶

    In [3]:
    Copied! 
    structure = StructureFactory.from_scratch(name='ncaf')
    structure = StructureFactory.from_scratch(name='ncaf')

    Set Space Group¶

    In [4]:
    Copied! 
    structure.space_group.name_h_m = 'I 21 3'
structure.space_group.coord_system_code = '1'
    structure.space_group.name_h_m = 'I 21 3' structure.space_group.coord_system_code = '1'

    Set Unit Cell¶

    In [5]:
    Copied! 
    structure.cell.length_a = 10.250256
    structure.cell.length_a = 10.250256

    Set Atom Sites¶

    In [6]:
    Copied! 
    structure.atom_sites.create(
    id='Ca',
    type_symbol='Ca',
    fract_x=0.4663,
    fract_y=0.0,
    fract_z=0.25,
    adp_iso=0.92,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    id='Al',
    type_symbol='Al',
    fract_x=0.2521,
    fract_y=0.2521,
    fract_z=0.2521,
    adp_iso=0.73,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    id='Na',
    type_symbol='Na',
    fract_x=0.0851,
    fract_y=0.0851,
    fract_z=0.0851,
    adp_iso=2.08,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    id='F1',
    type_symbol='F',
    fract_x=0.1377,
    fract_y=0.3054,
    fract_z=0.1195,
    adp_iso=0.90,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    id='F2',
    type_symbol='F',
    fract_x=0.3625,
    fract_y=0.3633,
    fract_z=0.1867,
    adp_iso=1.37,
)
structure.atom_sites.create(
    id='F3',
    type_symbol='F',
    fract_x=0.4612,
    fract_y=0.4612,
    fract_z=0.4612,
    adp_iso=0.88,
)
    structure.atom_sites.create( id='Ca', type_symbol='Ca', fract_x=0.4663, fract_y=0.0, fract_z=0.25, adp_iso=0.92, ) structure.atom_sites.create( id='Al', type_symbol='Al', fract_x=0.2521, fract_y=0.2521, fract_z=0.2521, adp_iso=0.73, ) structure.atom_sites.create( id='Na', type_symbol='Na', fract_x=0.0851, fract_y=0.0851, fract_z=0.0851, adp_iso=2.08, ) structure.atom_sites.create( id='F1', type_symbol='F', fract_x=0.1377, fract_y=0.3054, fract_z=0.1195, adp_iso=0.90, ) structure.atom_sites.create( id='F2', type_symbol='F', fract_x=0.3625, fract_y=0.3633, fract_z=0.1867, adp_iso=1.37, ) structure.atom_sites.create( id='F3', type_symbol='F', fract_x=0.4612, fract_y=0.4612, fract_z=0.4612, adp_iso=0.88, )

    🔬 Define Experiment¶

    This section shows how to add experiments, configure their parameters, and link the structures defined in the previous step.

    Download Data¶

    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    data_path56 = download_data('meas-ncaf-wish-b56', destination='data')
    data_path56 = download_data('meas-ncaf-wish-b56', destination='data')
    Getting data...

    Data 'meas-ncaf-wish-b56': NCAF, WISH (ISIS), Detector banks 5 & 6

    ✅ Data 'meas-ncaf-wish-b56' downloaded to '../../../data/meas-ncaf-wish-b56.xys'
    In [8]:
    Copied! 
    data_path47 = download_data('meas-ncaf-wish-b47', destination='data')
    data_path47 = download_data('meas-ncaf-wish-b47', destination='data')
    Getting data...

    Data 'meas-ncaf-wish-b47': NCAF, WISH (ISIS), Detector banks 4 & 7

    ✅ Data 'meas-ncaf-wish-b47' downloaded to '../../../data/meas-ncaf-wish-b47.xys'

    Create Experiment¶

    In [9]:
    Copied! 
    expt56 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path(
    name='wish_5_6',
    data_path=data_path56,
    beam_mode='time-of-flight',
)
    expt56 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path( name='wish_5_6', data_path=data_path56, beam_mode='time-of-flight', )
    In [10]:
    Copied! 
    expt47 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path(
    name='wish_4_7',
    data_path=data_path47,
    beam_mode='time-of-flight',
)
    expt47 = ExperimentFactory.from_data_path( name='wish_4_7', data_path=data_path47, beam_mode='time-of-flight', )

expt56.instrument.calib_d_to_tof_quadratic = -1.08308

    Peak types
    TypeDescription
    1pseudo-voigtTOF non-convoluted pseudo-Voigt profile
    2*jorgensenTOF Jorgensen profile: back-to-back exponentials ⊗ Gaussian
    3jorgensen-von-dreeleTOF Jorgensen-Von Dreele profile: back-to-back exponentials ⊗ pseudo-Voigt
    4double-jorgensen-von-dreeleTOF Double-Jorgensen-Von Dreele profile: double back-to-back exponentials ⊗ pseudo-Voigt (Z-Rietveld type0m)

    📦 Define Project¶

    The project object is used to manage the structure, experiments, and analysis

    Create Project¶

    In [21]:
    Copied! 
    project = Project(name='ncaf_wish')
    project = Project(name='ncaf_wish')

    Add Structure¶

    In [22]:
    Copied! 
    project.structures.add(structure)
    project.structures.add(structure)

    Add Experiment¶

    In [23]:
    Copied! 
    project.experiments.add(expt56)
project.experiments.add(expt47)
    project.experiments.add(expt56) project.experiments.add(expt47)
